about.title: About Me
about.bio: Computer Systems Analyst student with training in programming, databases, and web development. Knowledge of Python (basic), JavaScript, HTML, and CSS (early-intermediate level), basic use of MySQL, and foundational backend development in C. Analytical, organized, and committed to continuous learning. Interested in developing within technological environments where I can apply logic, data analysis, and process optimization. Highly motivated to learn new tools and methodologies according to team needs.
